full_prompt_en: A square biological illustration arranges a large spiral-shelled creature among leaves, flowers, and small specimen sketches on a warm cream paper ground. The main shell sits left of center, its tight raised coil rendered in beige, ochre, and small rust-red speckles. A brown segmented body and long slender feelers project from behind the shell toward the upper right. Below and beside it, dark green lance-shaped leaves cross a branching stem, carrying pale yellow buds, a few small orange fruits, and delicate pink blossoms. A deep magenta curved flower or pod occupies the lower center-right, creating the strongest color accent against the otherwise muted plant tones. Near the lower right, a cluster of ochre leaves spreads outward. The composition floats without a depicted table or landscape, so each overlapping stem and specimen remains easy to inspect. Around the central grouping, faint gray diagrams and thin measuring or alignment lines sit almost ghostlike on the paper. A pale fan-shaped anatomical sketch appears at the upper left, and small circular forms and seedlike shapes are scattered around the margins. These secondary marks stay much lighter than the colored central objects. Fine contour drawing and soft watercolor-like shading describe shell ridges, leaf veins, petal folds, and dry surfaces with careful observation. Light is even and warm, as on a well-lit study sheet, with modest shadows only where forms overlap. No clearly readable labels appear. The overall composition combines a precise natural-history plate with a decorative central bouquet, balancing quiet paper space and intricate organic detail.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形生物插图在暖奶油色纸底上安排一只大型螺旋壳生物，周围是叶、花和小标本草图。主壳位于中央偏左，紧卷的凸起螺线用米色、赭色和细小锈红斑点描绘。棕色分节身体与细长触角从壳后伸向右上。其下及身旁，深绿色披针形叶交叉在枝茎上，带浅黄花苞、几颗橙色小果和精巧粉花。一朵或一个深洋红弯曲花荚占据下方中央偏右，在其余柔和植物色中形成最强强调。右下附近，赭黄色叶簇向外展开。组合悬浮在纸面上，没有桌子或风景，使每根重叠茎和标本易于细看。主组合周围，淡灰图解与细测量或对齐线几乎如幽影般落在纸上。左上有浅色扇形解剖草图，页边散布小圆形与种子状形体。这些次要痕迹比中央彩色物件淡得多。细轮廓与柔和水彩般明暗仔细描绘壳纹、叶脉、花瓣褶和干燥表面。光均匀且温暖，像一张受良好照明的研究图纸，只有形体重叠处有适度阴影。没有清楚可读的标签。整体构图结合准确的自然史图版与装饰性中央花束，平衡安静纸面和精繁有机细节。
style_prompt_en: The image has a natural-history illustration finish, combining fine contour drawing, restrained translucent color, and pale auxiliary diagram marks on cream paper. A dense central cluster is surrounded by generous negative space, with thin guide lines and faint circular notes staying subordinate to the colored forms. Ochre, olive, beige, muted rose, and one stronger magenta accent create a measured hierarchy. Delicate hatching, stippling, and watercolor-like washes describe ridges, veins, and folds without heavy black outlines. Even warm light keeps the surfaces readable, while small overlap shadows provide depth. The overall effect is precise and graceful, joining scientific observation to a gently decorative arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有自然史插图完成感，在奶油纸上结合细轮廓、克制的透明色和淡辅助图解痕迹。密集中央簇团周围有充足留白，细引导线和浅圆记号从属于彩色形体。赭色、橄榄绿、米色、柔玫瑰色和一处较强洋红强调建立有节制的层级。细排线、点描和水彩般淡洗描述脊纹、叶脉与褶皱，没有厚重黑边。均匀暖光使表面容易阅读，小小重叠阴影提供纵深。整体效果准确而优雅，把科学观察与柔和装饰性的安排连接起来。
theme_en: A detailed biological plate of a spiral-shelled creature among leaves, flowers, and specimen sketches
theme_zh: 螺旋壳生物与叶片花朵及标本草图组成的细致生物图版
name: Biological illustration
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
